---
title: "News"
subtitle: "What's new in the Iacchei Lab?"
page-layout: full
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: inline
toc: false

include-in-header:
  - text: |
      <style> /* start of CSS */
       
        /* creates title block in header space */
        .quarto-title-block { 
          /* removes container constraints */
          margin-top: 0 !important;
          padding-top: 0 !important;
          padding-bottom: 0 !important;
          margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw); 
          /*continer to flexbox*/
          display: flex; 
          /*stacks title, subtitle, and description */
          flex-direction: column; 
          /*centers title, subtitle, and description horizontally and vertically */
          align-items: center; 
          justify-content: center; 
          /* makes height and width block fixed % of viewport */
          height: 80vh; 
          width: 100vw;
          /* centers text inside element */
          text-align: center; 
          /* removes default spacing */
          padding: 0; 
          /* makes block relative point for positioning other elements */
          position: relative; 
          /* background image */
          background-image: url("images/sample.png");
          background-size: cover; 
          background-position: center; 
          background-repeat: no-repeat; 
        }
        
        /* remove padding gap between navbar and header*/
        body[style*="padding-top"] { padding-top: 0 !important; }
        
        /* creates psuedo-element (overlay) before block */
        .quarto-title-block::before { 
          content: ""; 
          /* position of overlay over the block */
          position: absolute;
          top: 0;
          left: 0;
          width: 100%;
          height: 100%; 
          /* 40% black overlay */
          background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); 
          z-index: 0;
        }
        
        /* selects text */
        .quarto-title-block .title,
        .quarto-title-block .subtitle,
        .quarto-title-block .description { 
          position: relative; 
          z-index: 1; 
          color: white; 
        }
        
        /* specific title font preference */
        .title { 
          font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 5rem); 
          font-weight: bold;
          margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
        }
        
        /* specific subtitle font preference */
        .subtitle {
          font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem); 
          margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
        }
        
        /* specific description font preference */
        .description {
          font-size: clamp(0.9rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem); 
          max-width: 600px;
          margin: 0 auto; 
        }
      /* end of CSS */ </style>
      
about: 
  template: marquee
---

```{=html}
<style>
  {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

body {
  padding: 20px;
}

/* Header/Blog Title */
.header {
  padding: 30px;
  font-size: 50px;
  text-align: center;
}

/* Left column */
.leftcolumn {
  float: left;
  width: 75%;
}

/* Right column */
.rightcolumn {
  float: left;
  width: 25%;
  padding-left: 20px;
}

.rightcolumn p {
  margin: 0.1rem;
}

/* Video */
.vid {
  background-color: white;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 20px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

/* Add a card effect for articles */
.card {
      background: white;
      padding: 1.5rem;
      border-radius: 10px;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
      border-color: white;
      margin-bottom: 2rem;
    }

/* Clear floats after the columns */
.row:after {
  content: "";
  display: table;
  clear: both;
}

/* Responsive layout - when the screen is less than 800px wide, make the two columns stack on top of each other instead of next to each other */
@media screen and (max-width: 800px) {
  .leftcolumn, .rightcolumn {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 0;
  }
}
</style>

<head>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://maxcdn.bootstrapcdn.com/bootstrap/3.3.7/css/bootstrap.min.css">
</head>
```
